$description: One template per distinct page shape (29 shapes for 69 page routes; plus 2 non-page routes = the 71 routes of the route inventory). Node lists were derived from the page components, not copied from ia.json; each node carries section, variants, required and repeatable. The semantic validator matches PageSpec nodes on (section, variant) against this list, in order.

layouts.site: Global nav, footer and (unless excluded) the floating teaser.
layouts.standalone-own-chrome: Own header/footer or sidebar, no global chrome.

nonPageRoutes.note: Plain-text index served as a file; not a page shape, no PageSpec.

excludedRoutes.reason: Dev-only primitive showcase (rendered only in development builds); not a page template.

intentional404.reason: Term pages were deliberately not built; term links render the 404 page.

template.home.name: Homepage
template.home.description: Brand homepage: scroll-staged hero, proof bento, five-part gradient-flow story, stories carousel. Audited document heights 10669 / 10773 / 10950 / 9653 at 1440 / 1280 / 1000 / 390.

template.aeo-detail.name: Product / industry detail
template.aeo-detail.description: One data-driven template for 7 product and 3 industry answer pages. Optional nodes are pinned per route by routeNodeRules (exact data).

template.product-overview.name: Product overview
template.product-overview.iaJsonDiff: ia.json marks this template 'planned'; it is built and routed (src/pages/product/ProductHome.jsx, src/routes/product.jsx).

template.product-coach.name: Product: operations assistant

template.product-voice.name: Product: voice
template.product-voice.iaJsonDiff: ia.json marks it 'planned' and models the video and ticker as separate sections; the built hero section contains both.

template.get-a-demo.name: Get a demo
template.get-a-demo.description: Standalone viewport-height page: no nav, footer or teaser.

template.article-detail.name: Guide
template.article-detail.description: No video teaser: the sticky CTA chip replaces it.

template.competitor-detail.name: Kestrel vs a category

template.glossary.name: Glossary
template.glossary.description: Term links target /glossary/<slug>, which deliberately renders the 404 page; there is no term template.

template.company-about.name: About
template.company-about.iaJsonDiff: ia.json marks it 'planned' and lists content.split-text once; the built page renders it twice (mission H1, team H2).

template.company-careers.name: Careers
template.company-careers.iaJsonDiff: ia.json marks it 'planned'; it is built (src/pages/company/Careers.jsx) and routed in src/routes/product.jsx.

template.not-found.name: Not found
template.not-found.description: Rendered for any unknown path, for unknown detail slugs, and deliberately for /glossary/<slug> term links.
